info.title: LANywhere Self-host
info.author: LANywhere contributors
info.description: Local wireless play over the internet
info.details: Play compatible Switch games' Local Wireless mode online using a preset relay. Open the lobby in Album; use the optional Tesla-compatible overlay for status and controls. Requires Atmosphère and a restart. Replaces ldn_mitm with the same module ID. Physical overlay and two-console play are pending validation.\n\nAI use: Co-written with AI. AI also used for: description text.

changelog: First public beta with a lobby, local wireless sysmodule and Tesla-compatible overlay.
